newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast light crudes fade with March WTI.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast light crudes fade with March WTI.

text.p: Prices for U.S. West Coast light crudes faded Tuesday with the end of March WTI/Cushing trade, while players argued over the pricing basis for March barrels of Alaskan crude.
Buyers asked for March barrels of Alaska North Slope (ANS) at $1.60 off April WTI, and said they had no interest in pricing off March WTI, which last week had stayed as much as 30 cents over April.
The grade's major seller appeared to be close to selling a March cargo late Tuesday, according to traders, as the spread between April and March collapsed.
